From the beginning, our goal has been to offer a complete line of high quality products at competitive prices with a high level of customer service. With a focus on physical level Ethernet connectivity, we developed the first compact multi-AUI-port transceiver. Today, Canary offers a wide range of connectivity products, including: one, two, and four port transceivers; miniature repeaters; fan-outs; hubs; concentrators; multi-media repeaters; converters; and boosters. Looking to the future, our on-going research and development program will continue to keep our product line in the forefront of Ethernet LAN technology. Distribution Canary's products for the Ethernet LAN market are available through a network of authorized distributors, OEMs, VARs, and dealers.
